Entry YiTish Legend of the Long Night Yi Di's story about the Long Night retains the motif of darkness covering the world, order betrayed, and the eventual return of light. It does not prove that Westeros, Essos and the Far East have the same testable history, but it does prove that humans everywhere have used myths to face winter and death. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.
